selection_rationale: Location-sound references used on film/TV sets and taught in BTS audiovisuel: Sound Devices 833/888/MixPre-6 II, Zoom F8n Pro, and the Swiss/French heritage line (Nagra 4.2 analogue tape, Nagra VI, Nagra SEVEN/VII, Aaton Cantar-X from Grenoble). Handhelds common in French schools and media education (Zoom H6essential, TASCAM DR-40X, Portacapture X8), the TASCAM DA-6400 as the rack multitrack for live/broadcast capture, and the TASCAM SS-CDR250N as a theatre/installation playback deck. Playout systems are under-covered because the shared web-search budget ran out before vendor sites (RCS, ENCO, WinMedia, Netia) could be located; see not_found_log.

devices.why_it_is_a_classic: Rack-mount 64-track backup and live-capture recorder used alongside digital consoles and in broadcast trucks, taking MADI or Dante cards. It is a modern descendant of TASCAM's DA-series multitrack recorders.

key_specs.tracks: 64 channels maximum (44.1/48kHz sampling frequency); 32 channels maximum (88.2/96kHz sampling frequency)
key_specs.io_cards: IF-MA64/EX (64-ch MADI optical/BNC), IF-MA64/BN (MADI BNC), IF-DA64 (64-ch Dante, RJ-45), IF-AE16 (16-ch AES/EBU, D-sub 25p ×2), IF-AN16/OUT, IF-ST2110 (ST2110-30/AES67)
key_specs.timecode: TIME CODE IN/OUT on BNC, SMPTE 12M-1999 compliant
key_specs.word_video_sync: WORD/VIDEO IN on BNC (word or NTSC/PAL black burst, HDTV tri-Level); WORD/VIDEO THRU/OUT on BNC
key_specs.control: RS-422 9-pin D-sub; PARALLEL 15-pin D-sub; ETHERNET RJ45 (100BASE-TX, 1000BASE-T); USB 2.0 A type
key_specs.headphones: 6.3mm (1/4") standard stereo jack, 45 mW + 45 mW or higher
key_specs.power: AC 100-240V, 50/60Hz; 21 W (when IF-MA64/EX installed); DA-6400dp has two inlets
key_specs.weight: DA-6400: 3.9 kg; DA-6400dp: 4.0 kg (without I/O card or SSD case)

connectors.role: RS-422 (9-pin D-sub) - no DB-9 id, closest D-sub used
PARALLEL remote (15-pin D-sub) - closest D-sub id

devices.notes: AC mains inlet (two on the dp version) is not modelled because the inlet type is not stated. RS-422 DB-9 and parallel DB-15 mapped to dsub25 (closest id). French regional page exists (https://www.tascam.eu/fr/product/da-6400) but no French manual was found (tascam.eu returned 403).

conflicts.note: Spec sheet says 3.9 kg without I/O card or SSD case; other figures on the same page differ.

tekpractice.sim_value_reason: BNC timecode, word/video sync and MADI/Dante card options make it a good digital-transport and sync lesson.

devices.technology: 1U solid-state (SD/USB) + CD recorder/player with networking (FTP, Telnet), balanced/unbalanced analog and AES/EBU / S/PDIF I/O, optional Dante card
devices.why_it_is_a_classic: Rack recorder/player used for theatre and installation playback, archive recording and radio cart-style replay, with RS-232C, parallel (GPIO-type) and network control. TASCAM lists it in its installation system design guide.

key_specs.media: SD cards (512 MB – 2 GB); SDHC (4 GB – 32 GB); SDXC (64 GB – 128 GB); USB flash drives (512 MB – 128 GB); CD-R, CD-R-DA, CD-RW, CD-RW-DA
key_specs.analog_inputs: RCA pin jacks (-10 dBV); XLR-3-31 balanced (+4 dBu nominal line; mic with phantom power supported)
key_specs.analog_outputs: RCA pin jacks (-10 dBV); XLR-3-32 balanced (+4 dBu nominal)
key_specs.digital_io: AES/EBU XLR-3-31 in / XLR-3-32 out (AES3-2003/IEC60958-4); S/PDIF RCA in/out (IEC60958-3)
key_specs.dante_option: IF-DA2 interface card (sold separately) adds Dante 2ch input and output
key_specs.control: Remote 2.5 mm TRS; RS-232C D-sub 9-pin; Parallel D-sub 25-pin; Ethernet RJ45 100BASE-TX (FTP client/server, SNTP, Telnet); USB A-type
key_specs.snr: 106 dB or more (LINE IN to LINE OUT, JEITA)
key_specs.phones: 6.3 mm (1/4") standard stereo jack, 45 mW + 45 mW

connectors.role: balanced analog input L/R (line or mic with phantom)

devices.notes: Two manufacturer documents (product page + spec sheet) agree. The 'why' claim about the system design guide is based on the guide being linked from the product page. French regional page https://www.tascam.eu/fr/product/ss-cdr250n exists but returned 403; no French manual found.

tekpractice.sim_value_reason: Balanced XLR vs unbalanced RCA, AES vs S/PDIF and parallel GPIO remote on one rack unit: strong level/format lesson.
